tool_args.rationale: Fit the archived sink-inhibited siphon branches and competing Hill and barrier mechanisms numerically, selecting the best training residual for fresh confirmation. The broad-gradient observations resolve the principal pilot ambiguity; confirmation is still needed to establish forecast accuracy.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The acquired low- and high-gradient observations already expand the gradient span and provide seven rows for discriminating the candidate static laws.

considered_alternatives.option: Extra-fine trajectory batch and coupled ODE
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The observed concave input response and strong gradient dependence support a static sink-inhibited model; no observed temporal signature requires a coupled ODE.
The wide-gradient observations exhibit substantial sink dependence that those models omit.
